correctness.rationale: All-positive labels force each shattered support to be a chain; the explicit block-first permutation construction realizes every binary labeling on any chain. A separate disjoint-domain product lemma and strong induction show that every nonconstant root query has a yes child of Littlestone dimension n-2, bounding total dimension by n-1, while VC dimension provides the lower bound. Finite exhaustive checker verifies all n<=5 but infinite quantifiers are supported by proofs.

value.rationale: This fully classifies all shattered supports, not merely a finite table or scalar. It connects natural permutation-prefix membership to a canonical triangulated sphere and its Stirling/Eulerian face structure, while establishing an exact adaptive dimension of n-1 despite n! concepts and a substantially different query behavior from pairwise order comparisons. The structural identification explains exactly which query sets are learnable in the worst-case static and online senses.
